correctness.rationale: Independently rebuilt P13 Cayley adjacency residues {1,3,4,9,10,12}, verified 143 disconnected triples/facets and 7878 nonempty faces. Independently reproduced the prescribed 3936-pair sequential-vertex matching with 6 critical cells and full global Hasse acyclicity; integer Morse boundary C8→C7 has identical primitive columns (-1,-1,1), giving one unimodular cancellation, two 7-spheres and an unattached 8-sphere. All attaching maps S7→∨3S7 classified by degree vectors in this range. Homology in degrees7 and8 below pure top degree9 obstructs pure shellability. Package Alexander-dual mod2/multiple prime ranks are only corroboration, not proof of integrality; the exact signed integer matrix proves absence of torsion.

originality.rationale: Bayer et al arXiv:2304.13675 full paper inspected; it defines ordinary k-cut complexes and treats complete multipartite graphs, chordal/cycle graphs, general face-lattice and low-dimensional bounds. Theorem 6.1 requires complete codimension-one skeleton; in Paley13 the 8-dimensional face count 637 is less than all 715 possibilities, so this specific inference is unavailable. Resultary searches for ordinary P13 Δ3 and mixed S7/S8 returned other graphs or P13 neighborhood complex, not identical objects. Other Paley13 open-neighborhood/cut-type variants use different simplex predicates.
